notes.title: Update: Oculus Rift
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the most recent update has enabled support for the Oculus Rift! If you own a Oculus Rift and Oculus Grips, you will now be able to play alongside your friends on Vive and Oculus. We have also updated the game's tutorial to support both Vive and Rift users. 

We would like to extend special thanks to our friend "Ben Dover" on Steam, who has generously lent us his Rift during development and supported us in testing.

If you notice any new issues or are a new player who is having trouble with the game, please do not hesitate to let us know. This update has quite a few changes and there is a good chance we might have broken some things.

Thank you once again for playing Major League Gladiators, we appreciate every minute that someone decides to spend on our little game. Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Fixing the end of the game
notes.content: Today's update fixes the final achievement not unlocking as well as the game not returning players to the menu after beating the final wave. We're very sorry for any inconvenience this might have caused players.

notes.title: Update: Enabling (solo) player class selection
notes.content:
We have just released an update adding a new feature that allows players to select their prefered player class. This setting will be used when a player hosts a game, therefore enabling hosting and solo players to choose which class they would like to use. The default is still set to be Ranged.
Look for a new menu under the credits:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31147759/34a5071fca0dce68a330cde08193d89e4217ef15.jpg[/img]

We are also still working on support for the Oculus Rift, but are not ready to release it into the wild yet. Please stay tuned!
